sourceChecks.text: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honor in abundance; and he allied himself with Ahab.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: After some years, he went down to Ahab to Samaria. Ahab killed sheep and cattle for him in abundance, and for the people who were with him, and moved him to go up with him to Ramoth Gilead.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Ahab king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat king of Judah, “Will you go with me to Ramoth Gilead?” He answered him, “I am as you are, and my people as your people. We will be with you in the war.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab king of Israel, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One spoke saying in this way, and another saying in that way.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he had Ahab’s daughter as his wife. He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「アハブの家」は王家を指すため本人の出現には含めない。

sourceChecks.text: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to play the prostitute like Ahab’s house did, and also have slain your brothers of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「アハブの家」は王家を指すため本人の出現には含めない。

sourceChecks.text: He also walked in the ways of Ahab’s house, because his mother was his counselor in acting wickedly.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「アハブの家」は王家を指すため本人の出現には含めない。

sourceChecks.text: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「アハブの家」は王家を指すため本人の出現には含めない。

sourceChecks.text: He also followed their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead; and the Syrians wounded Joram.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アハブ本人ではなく、本文がヨラムを「アハブの子」と呼ぶ親族言及として保持。

sourceChecks.text: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Azariah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 候補名の指示対象を節本文・文脈で確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of God, in that he went to Joram; for when he had come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom the LORD had anointed to cut off Ahab’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「アハブの家」は王家を指すため本人の出現には含めない。

sourceChecks.text: When Jehu was executing judgment on Ahab’s house, he found the princes of Judah and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah serving Ahaziah, and killed them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「アハブの家」は王家を指すため本人の出現には含めない。
